name: qa-test-environment
description: Test environment setup: Testcontainers and Docker Compose services, Playwright fixtures, database snapshot and restore, and flag-aware test harnesses. Agents (test-environment-bootstrapper, db-snapshot-restore) wire a full integration environment for a greenfield service and reset the database between tests. Shared-state diagnosis composes with e2e-flake-bisector in qa-flake-triage.
